method: Live copy = Polydata-matched, joinable (40–12k closed, WR 48–75, median <$15k), HOT/WARM, unique-book ROI ≥5%, ≥40 events, ≥8 settled prints in 30d. extra_traders status=watch stays discovery until auto_promote flips to take_book. Auto-promote is automatic when joinable + HOT/WARM + (unique ROI≥5% or turnaround last30). Skip = 100k+ Polydata trades, 50k+ CSV rows, MM, kicked grinders, no CSV. Bench = take-book 12 who are stale, quiet, whale-sized, unique ROI too low, or take-rule bleed (unique green / asof_live_q60 red). Futures are not a copy lane (n=5, −37% after 2¢).
